text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano told a meeting of the Central Committee of his ruling Frelimo party yesterday that Frelimo and the government can take the credit for significant economic advances being made, such as a falling inflation rate, currency stability and increased exports.
- The tender for a feasibility study for a new dam to be built on the Zambezi river should be issued this month. The tender for the study alone will be worth between $8 and $10 million.
